cases.title: Select available seats and movie to calculate total price
cases.description: Verify that clicking available seats updates the selected seat count (data-testid="selected-count") and total price (data-testid="total-price") based on the selected movie price.

cases.title: Prevent selection of occupied seats
cases.description: Verify that clicking on seats marked with the occupied class does not change the selected seat count or total price.

cases.title: Toggle seat selection, persistence, and deselection
cases.description: Verify that clicking an available seat (e.g., data-testid="seat-1-1") toggles its selection, stores indices in localStorage, updates count and price, and allows deselection by clicking again.

cases.title: Load existing state from localStorage
cases.description: Verify that when 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex' are present in local storage upon webpage load, the corresponding seats are marked selected and the movie dropdown reflects the saved index.

cases.title: Default state when localStorage is empty
cases.description: Verify that if local storage lacks saved seat and movie keys, no seats are marked selected and the dropdown defaults to 'The Big Lebowski ($10)'.

cases.title: Dynamic price update on movie change with existing seat selection
cases.description: Verify that changing the movie selection after seats have been selected updates the total price according to the new ticket price while preserving the selected seat count.

cases.title: Verify seat status legends and interaction restrictions
cases.description: Verify that status legends are present (e.g., data-testid='seat-select'), occupied seats are non-interactive, and available seats correctly toggle states and update calculations.

opinions.feedback: All proposed high-level test cases are clear, distinct, cover all requirements properly, and are fully testable without any blockers.
All requirements and test cases align properly with no blockers found.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-1 defines normal interaction with the seat map and movie dropdown, edge cases such as changing the movie at any time, and boundary/abnormal cases like clicking on occupied seats which must not be selectable or affect count and price. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-2 specifies concrete movie options like 'The Big Lebowski ($10)' and 'Fargo ($12)', specific selectors like data-testid="seat-1-1", localStorage persistence, and deselection behavior. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-3 covers loading states, handling missing localStorage keys by defaulting to the first movie and zero selected seats, and applying existing keys ('selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex'). Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-4 reinforces dynamic calculations of count and total price, toggling selections, decreasing values on deselection, and preventing occupied seat selection. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-5 outlines visual status legends (e.g., data-testid='seat-select'), non-interactive occupied seats, and updating count and price upon selection or deselection.
